title: Chassis and Tiers
subtitle: Tier 1 iron, tier 2 steel
text:
The chassis is the frame every powered machine is built on, and it sets the tier.

Iron is tier 1. Steel is tier 2: the machine runs 1.5x faster, holds twice the energy and some machines reach further, such as the 9x9 Crop Harvester.
